senses.gloss: gomed, a length-measure, supposed to be the cubit less the hand’s length; arm. [Arakh. 11ᵃ וגָמְדָּהּ אמה Ar. and the arm of the scraper was one cubit, contrad. to היא itself, i.e. the perpendicular part; ed. וגובה.]—Pl. גְּמָדִים, גּוֹמָדִין.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 100a:10">B. Bath. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>שני גמ׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. a. Ar. <cite ref="C00674"><he>גו׳</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: a veil of a square gomed, used by Arabs in cold weather for covering the face.—Pl. גּוֹמָדִין.
units: Kel. XXIX, 1 הג׳ של ערביין.—Denom. גִּמֵּד to measure by the gomed. Tana d’be El. I, ch. XXXI (v. Lattes Saggio p. 84).
